column3: Manami Route ・ An Interlude in the Closing Ceremony
As I am now... I'm suffocating you, right?
What should I do... You don't want a girl like me, right...
Don't say stupid things like that!!
What I said earlier is the truth! There's no way I wouldn't like you as you are now, Manami!
That's not true, okay? So why are you...?
You're right... What? Why am I...
I think I'm... I'm just causing you trouble...
As, I, said! I told you earlier, right? You're not!
Yeah, really for real for real! How many times do I have to say it?!
You can't deal with this "restless" version of me, so you're saying that "being together is a bother."... Now I don't know what to do anymore... Buuuuh...
How... How can I go back to the old me!?
Because if I don't go back to the usual me, it'll cause more trouble for Kyou-chan!
Don't start saying that now! It's not about going back to your previous self, it's about how you act from now on! Shouldn't you think about how to act
Thank you... Even if it's just a lie... I'm happy... "New" me... Teeheehee.
Thank you... But you know, it looks like you're forcing yourself...
It seemed that way all this time...
It's true that I said, "You're not your usual self," but...
If you end up hating me, then...
I want you to just come out and say it...
Uh... Sorry... It's not easy to say, right..?
No and no, that's not it!
The thing I want to tell you, is not something like that.
